Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.history.performance

Class OptimizationDecision

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.history.performance.OptimizationDecision
public class OptimizationDecision extends Object
Represents a decision made by the illustration performance optimizer.

This class encapsulates the optimizer's decision about whether and how to proceed with illustration generation, including the reasoning behind the decision for debugging and analysis purposes.
